[Intro]

Tracing shadows on the peeling wall
Watching the evening shadows start to fall
A single candle flickers in the haze
Lost inside the rhythm of my maze

Listen to the secrets that the shadows bring
Every word is heavy, every breath is deep
Promises we made are ours to keep

Listen to the secrets that the shadows bring
Every word is heavy, every breath is deep

Nowhere left for my restless heart to hide
[Chorus]
Hold the silence like a holy thing
Listen to the secrets that the shadows bring
Every word is heavy, every breath is deep
Promises we made are ours to keep
[Outro]
